sources.title: Ona Overview
sources.finding: New customer signup closed; existing customers and new members of existing orgs continue. Interactive sessions and automated fleets on own AWS/GCP VPC are documented.

sources.title: Ona Codex Agent
sources.finding: Codex harness in Ona environment on AWS/GCP; Core+ with org enablement and runner OpenAI-compatible integration. Enterprise BYOK. Model/effort/Fast/Goal mode subject to org controls.

sources.title: Ona Automations
sources.finding: Prompts/commands/PR/report steps run in isolated dev environments. Manual/schedule/PR/webhook triggers; laptop need not be on. Core/Enterprise limits apply.

sources.title: Ona Automation configuration
sources.finding: Sequential prompt/command/PR/report steps in one environment. Service accounts for scheduled work with permission checks. Disable preserves config/history but prevents new runs.

sources.title: Ona Automation limits
sources.finding: Core 50 automations/10 parallel/50 total actions; Enterprise unlimited definitions/25 parallel/1000 total system ceiling. Webhook sources Enterprise; Core GitHub PR triggers available.

sources.title: Ona Runner architecture
sources.finding: Ona-hosted management plane coordinates; user VPC runners execute code and hold SCM credentials. AWS EC2/GCP Compute VMs provide environments; infrastructure managed by customer.

sources.title: Ona Persistent storage
sources.finding: VM disk persists stop/start. Repository bind mount preserves uncommitted code on rebuild; other filesystem recreated unless mounted. Prebuilds snapshot environment.

sources.title: Ona Archive and deletion
sources.finding: Core archives after 3 inactive days then deletes after 4 more; Enterprise timings configurable including never-delete. Deleted content permanently removed.

sources.title: Ona CLI
sources.finding: Product-owned ona CLI with macOS/Linux/Windows downloads manages environments (create/start/stop/delete), SSH, ports, prebuilds, webhooks and environment tasks/services; browser login and personal access token authentication documented.

sources.title: Ona SDK
sources.finding: Python/TypeScript/Go SDK creates environments, runs commands and launches Codex.

sources.title: Ona Agent skills
sources.finding: Reusable SKILL.md instructions guide agent workflows; project/repository and organization skill context.

sources.title: Ona MCP integrations
sources.finding: Configured external MCP tools extend agents; config in repository or organization integrations with OAuth/secrets.

sources.title: Ona Organization roles
sources.finding: Enterprise scoped admin roles plus Insights/Audit/Billing viewers; group assignment and immediate role revocation.

sources.title: Ona SSO
sources.finding: Enterprise OIDC SSO supports multiple IdPs/domains; org admins configure and verify domains. Deactivation does not invalidate existing login sessions.

sources.title: Ona Guardrails
sources.finding: Identity, org policy, runtime command/executable restrictions and audit logs; kernel Veto described separately from broad deny-list controls.

sources.title: Ona Cost and budgets
sources.finding: Core OCU balance/daily usage chart; standard 4vCPU/16GB 1 OCU/hour and GPU 7 OCUs/hour. Enterprise uses separate credits/BYOK usage API; no current USD starting price.

sources.title: Ona SCM tools
sources.finding: GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket PR create/read/update/merge/comment and CI status. Cannot approve/request changes or sync PR base branch; group controls can disable tools.

sources.title: Ona Dev Containers
sources.finding: devcontainer.json defines version-controlled dependencies, Docker Compose services, mounts and tools; Dev Container image cache and Tasks and Services are documented.

sources.title: Ona changelog
sources.finding: Mac Desktop security release requires macOS13+. Review file tree/inline diffs/comments and Plan mode spec.md documented as shipped. August31 model-access fix prevents inherited access token overriding configured access.

sources.title: Ona current procurement
sources.finding: /pricing redirects to contact/sales; no current public recurring USD price.

sources.title: Ona service terms
sources.finding: Company service access is licensed under commercial terms; service source-reversal/copying restrictions distinct from third-party open-source components.

sources.title: Ona joining OpenAI
sources.finding: Ona states transaction officially closed August 10, 2026 and company is part of OpenAI.

sources.title: Ona Cloud is shutting down on October 31, 2026
sources.locator: October 13 announcement; Can I keep using Ona Cloud; How do I save my work; refunds; automatic migration FAQ
sources.finding: Ona announces Cloud wind-down on October 31, 2026; existing Cloud access only until that date and new signup already closed. Customers must back up code/files; October payments and unused purchased credits refunded. Environments do not migrate automatically to Codex. Enterprise or self-hosted offerings are not stated to end.

sources.title: Ona CLI
sources.finding: The complete CLI download table supplies native macOS, Linux and Windows binaries for x86_64 and arm64. This establishes CLI client platforms, separately from the macOS GUI desktop app.

sources.title: Ona runners
sources.locator: Runner responsibilities; Management Plane/Runners; Deployment options
sources.finding: The management plane coordinates while runners in the customer VPC execute agents. Current Enterprise deployment options are AWS EC2 environments or Google Cloud Compute environments; agent execution is on those runners, not the local client.

sources.title: Ona Development Container configuration
sources.locator: Single/multi-container support; Recovery mode; CLI rebuild
sources.finding: Ona explicitly supports single- and multi-container Development Containers. If the configured container fails to build/start, Ona mounts the workspace in a temporary recovery container, then removes it and reconnects to the rebuilt Dev Container. This describes container execution, not only a configuration file; host-network limitations are documented.

sources.title: Ona model access
sources.locator: Codex Agent model access; Custom token providers
sources.finding: Current AWS/GCP Codex Agent access requires a configured OpenAI-compatible provider integration. Documented routes are OpenAI direct API, AWS Bedrock Runtime and Bedrock Mantle with organization/provider credentials. Custom token providers require Enterprise exception approval; a personal ChatGPT/Claude subscription login is not a documented native access route.

sources.title: Ona current access
sources.finding: New customer signup is closed. Existing customers and new members joining existing organizations can continue using Ona; new users are directed to Codex. This does not establish acceptance or prices for a new paid evaluation.

sources.title: Ona docs: Ona SDK
sources.finding: The SDK (Python, TypeScript, Go) is available on the Enterprise plan. SDK versions 1.x introduce a new API that is not compatible with 0.x; package names stay the same, so code must be updated when upgrading.

sources.title: Ona docs: Overview
sources.finding: New customer signup is closed; existing customers and new members of existing organizations continue. Existing organizations run Ona in their own VPC on AWS or GCP and can start a single interactive session or run agents on a schedule, on PR events or from the issue tracker. Issues can be assigned to Ona in Linear. Environments are ephemeral and isolated, with SSO, OIDC and SCIM built in.

sources.title: Ona docs: Linear
sources.locator: What agents can do with Linear; Start a session from an issue
sources.finding: Once connected, agents can create Linear issues, move issues to In Progress and Done, search issues and add comments that document findings or link PRs. Mentioning the agent in an issue comment or delegating (assigning) the issue to Ona starts a session that reads the issue and posts progress back; the session runs under the user's identity, or as the assignee when assigned on someone's behalf.

sources.title: Ona docs: Web browser
sources.locator: Intro; Where the browser is available
sources.finding: A built-in browser runs inside the environment; when Ona AI is enabled users can share page state with Ona and send screenshots from the Browser tab into the conversation (Annotate browser, Send screenshot to Ona). Enterprise admins can disable the browser by policy.

sources.title: Ona docs: Archive & auto-delete
sources.finding: Core: stopped environments archive after 3 days and auto-delete 4 days after archival. Enterprise: archive after 3 days by default, configurable 1-30 days; auto-delete configurable 1-4 weeks or never. The ona CLI archives an environment with ona environment archive <id-or-name>.

sources.title: Ona docs: Architecture overview
sources.finding: The management plane (auth, organizations, guardrail enforcement, runner coordination, dashboard and API) is hosted by Ona. Runners in the customer's AWS or GCP handle environment provisioning, source access, secrets, agent execution and builds.

sources.title: Ona docs: Veto
sources.locator: Intro; Capabilities (executable deny list); Kernel-level enforcement
sources.finding: Veto runs as a Linux Security Module inside the environment kernel and blocks admin-listed binaries by content hash (rename- and symlink-resistant); the agent cannot unload it or change its configuration. Vendor statement; no independent security test.

sources.title: Ona docs: User budgets
sources.finding: Enterprise user budgets give each member a monthly credit or BYOK cost allowance shown on Cost & Budgets. Budgets are soft: for reporting and visibility, not enforced at usage time; users over budget can keep creating environments and running agents.

sources.title: Ona docs: Teams
sources.finding: Team credit budgets are soft, used for reporting and alerting only and not enforced at usage time.

sources.title: Ona docs: Auto-stop timeout
sources.locator: Configuration; Effect on users; Set a default auto-stop timeout
sources.finding: Environments auto-stop after an idle timeout: 30 minutes by default; users choose 30 minutes, 1 hour, 3 hours, 8 hours or Never, capped by an organization maximum policy (Core plan or higher).

sources.title: Ona docs: Insights
sources.finding: Enterprise Insights shows Velocity, AI Adoption and Platform usage, filterable by date range, project and team, aggregated daily or weekly; Velocity and AI Adoption need per-project enablement.

sources.title: Ona docs: AI cost usage API
sources.locator: Intro; Ona Intelligence or BYOK table
sources.finding: Enterprise AI cost usage API exposes BYOK spend: organization totals, per-team and per-user attribution with budgets and a daily time series, for export to finance tools. Ona Intelligence credit usage has a separate usage API.

sources.title: Ona docs: Report step
sources.finding: A Report step defines typed outputs that the agent extracts by prompt or command after earlier steps; results appear in a table with CSV export on the execution summary, only for executions with more than one action.

sources.title: Ona docs: Sharing resources
sources.locator: Share a project (role table); Remove access
sources.finding: Enterprise project admins share projects with users, groups or everyone as User (view and use), Editor (settings, secrets, environment classes) or Admin (full control including sharing and deletion); the creator becomes admin.

sources.title: Ona docs: Command deny list
sources.locator: How it works; Pattern matching; Configuration
sources.finding: Admins add command patterns in Settings > Agents > Policies; a matching agent command is blocked with an error message. Slash commands are not filtered; changes apply to new agent sessions.

sources.title: Ona Cloud is shutting down on October 31, 2026
sources.finding: Ona Cloud wound down on October 31, 2026. To save work, ask the agent to commit and push code and back up other files separately. All October payments and unused purchased credits at shutdown are refunded. Environments do not move to Codex automatically.

sources.title: Ona docs: Ona Cloud
sources.finding: Ona Cloud is no longer available; Enterprise organizations continue using runners in their own AWS or GCP infrastructure.

sources.title: Privacy policy · Ona
sources.locator: website analytics sections (Google Analytics, Segment, Mixpanel) and use of personal data from the Ona Service
sources.finding: The policy lists Google Analytics, Segment and Mixpanel for website analytics, each deactivatable via the browser's Do Not Track setting, and says Ona may analyze personal data from use of the Ona Service to improve it. It does not say whether the Ona web app, desktop app, Ona CLI or VS Code extension send usage telemetry, or describe an in-product control.

sources.title: Gitpod CLI (Ona docs)
sources.finding: The legacy Gitpod workspace CLI sends anonymous telemetry (command name, exception information, anonymous machine ID) by default; 'gitpod config set --telemetry=false' or DO_NOT_TRACK disables it. The current Ona CLI reference (ona.com/docs/ona/reference/cli.md) and VS Code extension page do not mention telemetry.
